# Local Draco glTF decoders

Copied without modification from the installed three@0.185.1 package, examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/, on 2026-09-22. These files are served from this site so scene loading does not depend on access to Google gstatic.

Source directory: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r185/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf

The package's Draco README is retained as UPSTREAM-README.md and identifies the decoders as Apache 2.0 licensed. DRACO-LICENSE.txt is the complete official license text retrieved from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/draco/1.5.7/LICENSE. THREE-LICENSE.txt retains the distributing package's MIT notice. The three package version and checksums identify the copied binaries; a separate Draco binary release version is not inferred.
